title: A security advisory
description: One file of advisories/, named <id>.json, filed by an admin only. A later change only appends releases or withdraws it; it is never deleted. The machine check (botmaker-cli's EntryGate) is the authority; this schema describes the file's shape only.

id.description: BMA-<year>-<4 digits>, in sequence per year, and the file's name.

repo.description: The entry's owner/name, or one it had formerly.

releases.description: The affected tags, each an approved release of the entry.

url.description: Where the problem is described; left out for none.

withdrawn.description: Why it no longer holds; left out while it does.
